description: The bar chart illustrates the “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)” for two large language models — GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini — across three experimental conditions: Control, Before Introspection Training, and After Introspection Training. The vertical axis ranges from 0.00 to 1.00, representing the accuracy of self-reported preferences, with tick marks at 0.25 intervals. For GPT-4o, the Control condition (gray bar) shows low accuracy (~0.15), Before Introspection Training (teal bar) improves to ~0.55, and After Introspection Training (purple bar) further increases to ~0.75. For GPT-4o-mini, the Control condition is near zero (~0.01), Before Introspection Training reaches ~0.50, and After Introspection Training rises to ~0.75. Error bars indicate variability, with larger error margins for the Control condition and smaller ones for the trained conditions. The chart visually supports the paper’s claim that introspection training enhances LLMs’ ability to accurately report their internal decision-driving processes, with both models showing substantial gains post-training, and GPT-4o-mini achieving comparable post-training accuracy to GPT-4o despite starting from a lower baseline.
